$description: CLEAR Design System — Effect tokens. Atmospheric elements that make the system feel alive. Applied as seasoning, not the main course.

scanlines.$description: Faint horizontal lines overlaid on surfaces. Creates 'this is a display, not a window' feeling. Reference: Alien CRTs, Cyberpunk 2077 panel overlays.

pattern.$description: Repeating gradient: 2px transparent, 2px white at 8% opacity

grain.$description: SVG fractal noise texture overlay. Subtle film grain that adds imperfection.

darkOverlay.$description: Dark scrim between animated background and content. Ensures readability.

glow.$description: Subtle light emission on key elements. Makes elements feel emissive, not painted. Uses currentColor adaptation. Reference: Alien phosphor persistence, Eva active-status indicators.

emissive.$description: text-shadow glow for data readouts and emphasis

strong.$description: Stronger glow for hero elements (logo, timer, streak numbers)

pulse.$description: Micro-pulse — barely perceptible brightness oscillation on structural elements. Stepped timing to match mechanical motion language. Reference: Star Wars indicator lights, Eva nominal-status pulses.

staggerReveal.$description: Children materialize in sequence on page load. Mechanical timing: stepped, not smooth. Reference: Alien character-by-character text, Blade Runner stepped zoom.

maxItems.$description: Max children that get stagger delay

tabEnter.$description: Tab content enter animation. Stepped opacity, mechanical feel.

ghostButton.$description: Transparent button with inset glow. Structure color border + subtle inner radiance.

background.$description: Animated gradient blob system. Drifting, overlapping radial gradients create a living backdrop.

motion.$description: Global motion principles. Mechanical, not organic. Stepped, not eased.

transitionSlow.$description: ChamferedFrame color breathe — the one atmospheric exception
